project_name: OOP Lab 1: Space Vessel Management System
summary: A C# Windows Forms application demonstrating core OOP principles through a space fleet management simulation. It models a hierarchical spacecraft architecture with dynamic UI components and polymorphic fleet management.
technologies: Visual Studio / JetBrains Rider / VS Code
key_features: Multi-level class hierarchy with abstract base and sealed derived classes
Polymorphic fleet management using heterogeneous collections
Dynamic UI component switching based on runtime selection
Custom indexers for array-based cargo log management
Strict encapsulation with validated properties and protected constructors
achievements: Successfully implemented a comprehensive OOP architecture in a desktop UI environment, resolving challenges in dynamic component loading, polymorphic state rendering, and data validation. Engineered a scalable class hierarchy with custom indexers and sealed classes to enforce design constraints, while structuring the codebase for future architectural migrations (MVVM/MVP) and deterministic resource management.
